title: Arista Networks Q2 2026 results, SEC-filed Exhibit 99.1
publisher: Arista Networks, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 3.036 billion, up 37.7% year over year, GAAP operating margin was 45.4%, and GAAP diluted EPS was USD 0.95; Q3 guidance called for approximately USD 3.3 billion of revenue.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release confirms Q2 revenue, margins and EPS plus Q3 revenue and non-GAAP guidance used to normalize the 12-month earnings scenarios.
